name: Tughlaq dynasty
short_desc: A Delhi Sultanate dynasty expands widely before regional revolts and fragmentation weaken its rule.
date_note: Uses the last Tughlaq ruler’s death in 1413; some umbrella chronologies extend this phase to the Sayyid takeover in 1414.
notes: Initial article identity, date meaning and source review completed. Summary authored for this catalog; independent claim-specific citations remain open.
